review.note: The item carries no P625 and its P276 is Q40942, the state of Pernambuco, which would put a battle on a whole province. The place is the town instead, from the record’s own cited article: revision 1370618669 gives the location as “Morro dos Guararapes (present-day Jaboatão dos Guararapes, Pernambuco, Brazil)”, and the Second Battle’s item puts its own P625 on that town’s point. No coordinate was invented.

title: First Battle of Guararapes
summary: The English Wikipedia article "First Battle of Guararapes", at revision 1370618669, opens: "The First Battle of Guararapes took place during the Insurrection of Pernambuco, between Dutch and Portuguese forces in Pernambuco, in a dispute for the dominion of that part of the Portuguese colony of Brazil." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5452519, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1648 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
